aiStyling.title: AI Styling
aiStyling.description: Describe the change in plain language and AI rewrites the CSS — compare before and after right on the page.

record.title: Record & Replay
record.description: Record live, or grab the last 30 seconds from the always-on replay — catch the bug even after spotting it.

ai.title: AI Report
ai.description: Turn captured data into a structured report with steps, expected, and actual behavior.

autoCollect.title: Auto-Collect Context
autoCollect.description: Browser, resolution, and DOM context come with every report — no more asking the reporter what setup they were on.

logsViewer.title: Log Viewer
logsViewer.description: Open the attached log viewer and the video plays in sync with console, network, and action logs.

submit.title: One-Click Issue Filing
submit.description: Submit tickets with full attachments to Jira, GitHub, Linear, Notion, and more in one click.

trackIssues.title: Track Issue Status
trackIssues.description: Check the status of submitted issues in real time inside BugShot, and update them without opening your tracker.

connectTracker.title: Connect your tracker
connectTracker.description: Link Jira, GitHub, Linear, Notion, and more via OAuth or API key. Projects, labels, assignees, and priorities sync automatically — no reconfiguration needed when filing issues. See the <guide>Integrations</guide> docs for details.

captureMode.title: Choose a capture mode
captureMode.description: Inspect mode captures the DOM and styles in one click. Add annotations to a screenshot to pinpoint the issue, or record up to 60 seconds to show how to reproduce it. Already missed the bug? The always-on 30-second replay has you covered. Every mode auto-collects console logs and network requests — headers and bodies included, sensitive headers masked.

editStyles.title: Edit the styles
editStyles.description: Click any element to edit CSS directly, or ask AI to change styles in plain language. Before-and-after snapshots and a diff table of changed properties are automatically included in the report. See the <guide>Element Styling</guide> docs for details.

aiDraft.title: AI generates a draft
aiDraft.description: Feeds collected environment info, logs, screenshots, and style diffs into AI to generate a structured report with reproduction steps, expected behavior, and actual behavior. Chrome's built-in AI works instantly; OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini just need an API key. See the <guide>AI settings</guide> docs for details.

submitReport.title: Submit your report
submitReport.description: File the report to your tracker in one click. Screenshots and recordings, console, network, and action logs bundled into a log viewer, plus an AI-ready context Markdown file all come attached — a bug report developers and AI can consume right away.

trackIssues.title: Check issue status
trackIssues.description: View issue status in real time right inside BugShot. Transition Jira workflows, toggle GitHub Open/Closed, or change Linear states — all without leaving BugShot to open your tracker.

qe.author: 안**, QA Engineer
qe.quote: I used to juggle DevTools, screenshots, and Jira separately — now it all happens in the browser without breaking my flow. Replacing text explanations with visual diffs and recordings cut our back-and-forth way down.

designer.author: 김**, Product Designer
designer.quote: During design QA, I used to dig through DevTools to find element positions and capture changes separately. Now I can inspect and share fixes right on the page — the whole process is so much smoother.

backend.author: 성**, Backend Engineer
backend.quote: QA tickets that just say “it doesn’t work” are over. Network requests and console errors come attached automatically, so I see which API broke right away, and the AI drafts the repro steps. Debugging time dropped a lot.

frontend.author: 문**, Frontend Engineer
frontend.quote: I used to burn time reproducing bugs that came in as a single screenshot. Now one capture bundles console errors, network logs, and environment info automatically, so half the cause is visible the moment it lands.

bottomCta.heading: All your Bugs, <brand>One Workflow</brand>.
subcopy: From bug discovery to issue submission —

browser.a: BugShot works on Chrome and Chromium-based browsers like Edge, Brave, and Arc. Chrome 116 or later is required. New here? See the <guide>Quick Start guide</guide>.

pricing.a: Yes, completely free with no sign-up required. Install from the <store>Chrome Web Store</store> and start reporting right away.

ai.q: What do I need to use the AI feature?
ai.a: Chrome's built-in AI works out of the box with no setup. To use external LLMs like OpenAI, Anthropic, or Gemini, just enter your own API key. See the <guide>AI settings guide</guide> for details.

integrations.a: Submit reports with attachments directly to Jira, GitHub, Linear, Notion, GitLab, and Asana. You can also copy as Markdown and paste it wherever your team works. See the <guide>Integrations guide</guide> for setup details.

privacy.a: All data is stored locally in your browser and is never sent to BugShot's servers. Data is only shared with the services you use — your issue tracker or AI provider — and local data is automatically deleted after submission.
